meanings.usage: 描述人对某事感到期待和高兴的情绪
表示从一地到另一地的移动
妇女随身携带的化妆工具
形容因他人的行为而感到不好意思

phrases.usage: 被邀请参加（某个活动或聚会）

examples.en: Sally was invited to a children's party.
examples.zh: 莎莉被邀请去参加一个儿童派对。

examples.en: I decided to take her by train.
She sat near the window and asked questions.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗边问了很多问题。

examples.en: A middle-aged lady got on the train.
examples.zh: 一位中年女士上了火车。

examples.en: She sat opposite Sally.
The lady took out her powder compact.
examples.zh: 那位女士拿出了她的粉盒。

examples.en: She began to make up her face.
She put away her compact.
She asked questions about everything she saw.
examples.zh: 她问关于她看到的一切的问题。

sentences.en: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.
sentences.zh: 上周，我四岁的女儿萨莉应邀参加了一个儿童聚会。

sentences.en: I decided to take her by train.
Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.
sentences.zh: 萨莉非常兴奋，因为她以前从未坐过火车。

sentences.en: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
sentences.zh: 她坐在窗边，对看到的一切都问个不停。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a middle-age lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
sentences.zh: 突然，一位中年妇女上了火车，坐在萨莉对面。

sentences.en: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
sentences.zh: 萨莉没有回答，只是好奇地看着她。

sentences.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
sentences.zh: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套，戴着一顶又大又滑稽的帽子。

sentences.en: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
sentences.zh: 火车离开车站后，那位女士打开手提包，拿出她的粉饼盒。

sentences.en: She then began to make up her face.
'Why are you doing that?' Sally asked.
sentences.zh: “你为什么要那样做？”萨莉问道。

sentences.en: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.
sentences.zh: “为了让自己变漂亮。”那位女士回答。

sentences.en: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
sentences.zh: 她收起粉饼盒，和蔼地笑了笑。

sentences.en: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.
Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
sentences.zh: 萨莉觉得很有趣，但我却感到非常难为情！

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去正在发生的事情，常与when/while连用

examples.en: Sally was sitting near the window when a lady got on.
examples.zh: 当一位女士上车时，莎莉正坐在窗边。

examples.en: The lady was dressed in a blue coat.
examples.zh: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套。

grammar.title: 特殊疑问句 - Why 引导的原因疑问句
grammar.structure: Why + be动词/助动词 + 主语 + ...?
grammar.usage: 询问某人做某事的原因

examples.en: Why are you doing that?
Why was the mother embarrassed?

grammar.title: but连接的转折句
grammar.definition: 用but连接两个意思相反的句子
grammar.usage: 表示前后意思的转折对比

examples.en: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
examples.zh: 莎莉觉得好笑，但我却非常尴尬！

patterns.pattern: Why + be动词/助动词 + 主语 + 动词-ing?

examples.en: Why are you laughing?
Why is she crying?

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has + never + 过去分词

original.en: She had never travelled on a train before.

examples.en: I have never been to Beijing.
He has never flown a plane.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be动词 + 形容词, but + 主语 + be动词 + 形容词

original.en: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!
original.zh: 莎莉觉得好笑，但我却非常尴尬！

examples.en: He was happy, but she was sad.
The book was interesting, but the movie was boring.
examples.zh: 这本书很有趣，但电影很无聊。
